project.styleDefinitionBrief: Dark dashboard, Anodized Deep surface ladder + indigo #5e6ad2 single brand hue, Inter ss03 + JetBrains Mono, 1px hairlines not shadows, Linear/Raycast caliber.

styleContinuityAnchors.typographySystem: Inter + JetBrains Mono; ss03/cv01/cv03/cv04 features; tabular-nums globally; negative letter-spacing on headings
styleContinuityAnchors.colorSystem: Single brand hue indigo #5e6ad2; 4-step dark surface ladder #08090a→#0d0d0f→#121214→#161619; hairline #24272b; state colors #59d499/#ffc533/#ff6161/#57c1ff semantic-only
styleContinuityAnchors.shapeSystem: radius 4px/8px/16px only; no radius above 16px; pill only for tags/avatars
styleContinuityAnchors.surfaceAndDepth: Static cards use 1px hairline borders, no shadow; floating layers (modal/popover/dropdown) may use shadow-2/shadow-3

sidebar.activeState: primary text + left 2px primary bar; geometry stays identical
sidebar.bottomSection: bot-status card with name, connection state, uptime

sharedProjectShellContract.surfaceDepthModel: 4-step dark ladder: canvas→surface→surface-elevated→surface-card; 1px hairline borders for static; shadow only for floating layers
sharedProjectShellContract.typographySystem: Inter (ss03) for UI text; JetBrains Mono for code/logs/data; tabular-nums; heading letter-spacing -0.02em
